question: Who wrote the autobiography 'Childhood Days: A Memoir'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satyajit Ray**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Satyajit Ray** was a renowned Indian filmmaker, screenwriter, author, music composer, and graphic designer. He is widely regarded as one of the greatest filmmakers of all time.
 
• The autobiography **"Childhood Days: A Memoir"** was written by **Satyajit Ray**, offering insights into his early life, education, and creative journey.
 
• The book reflects Ray's experiences growing up in **Kolkata**, his family's cultural background, and the influences that shaped his artistic vision.
